Description
The University of Bath is a public research university located in Bath, Somerset, United Kingdom. Ranked 8th best university in the UK by the Guardian University Guide 2022Ranked 9th best overall by The Times and The Sunday Times Good University Guide 2022Ranked 10th best university in the UK in the Complete University Guide 2022Ranked 9th in The Times Higher Education 'Table of Tables' 2022Placed in the Top 100 globally of the QS Graduate Employability Rankings 202286% for overall student satisfaction in the National Student Survey 2021 - ranked 1st in England and 2nd in the UK when comparing institutions listed in the Guardian University Guide Ranked 4th in the UK in The Times Higher Education Student Experience Survey 20181st for Architecture and Criminology2nd for Psychology, Sociology, Management, and Sports Science3rd for Civil Engineering and Mechanical Engineering
